articles.title: SEC Exec Says League Won't Budge on Letting NFL Players Return to CFB, 'Enough Is Enough'
articles.summary: As the college football world waits to see whether former NFL players will be officially added to LSU's roster for the 2026 season, Tennessee chancellor and president of the SEC's executive committee Donde Plowman made the league's position on the issue perfectly clear.
articles.body:
As the college football world waits to see whether former NFL players will be officially added to LSU's roster for the 2026 season, Tennessee chancellor and president of the SEC's executive committee Donde Plowman made the league's position on the issue perfectly clear.

"We have a responsibility to try and lead the best we can in this time of chaos," Plowman said while adding the SEC is "prepared to defend our rules," per ESPN's Pete Thamel and Mark Schlabach . "Our group is united on this. This is not a rule we will budge on. Enough is enough."

Zxavian Harris and Dae'Quan Wright both previously signed NFL deals but plan on playing for LSU during the upcoming campaign.

With that looming, the SEC issued a statement last month saying it planned on preventing athletes from returning to the college ranks after they joined NFL teams.

Yet a Texas judge issued an order overruling that statement. What's more, Thamel and Schlabach noted the SEC taking immediate action to punish LSU would violate a standing court order issued by a judge in Louisiana stating the league cannot keep players involved in an ongoing lawsuit off the field.

Plowman explained she and her colleagues are concerned with the "narrow" issue of former NFL players returning to the college ranks, which she called a "line in the sand" that is separate from others looking for a fifth year of eligibility.

"It's not a new rule," Plowman said. "We didn't just cook up a rule. It's not a new rule. The way we see it. We are a voluntary membership organization, and we have a right to set and enforce our rules. We want to clarify—this is not about the five-for-five.

"This is about—if you signed a contract, you signed a contract. That's always been the bottom line. You don't get to un-sign it and come back."

According to Thamel and Schlabach, a Thursday hearing in a Louisiana state court could lead to a preliminary injunction allowing the players in question to take the field for the Tigers. However, LSU would have to decide if playing them is worth the risk of future punishments from the SEC.

That is notable since Plowman said SEC commissioner Greg Sankey "has the full spectrum of penalties that he can use. He needs to feel he has our authority to use those."

The comments come after the SEC passed penalties that included suspending a coach half the season and docking league voting rights and half of the sport's annual budget for violators who play former NFL players.

For his part, LSU head coach Kiffin told Thamel he is in "daily communication" with the SEC regarding the issue.

The Tigers face Clemson in a highly anticipated season opener on Saturday.

articles.title: Folarin Balogun transfer news: Everton deal collapses after Monaco striker walks away
articles.summary: Everton's pursuit of Folarin Balogun from Monaco collapses after Balogun decides against move.
articles.body:
Everton 's move for Folarin Balogun collapsed after the player decided against proceeding with a transfer.

The deal was renegotiated after Everton initially agreed a £40m deal with Monaco for Balogun, 25, because of an issue with his medical.

The United States striker is understood to have decided against going ahead with the move.

Everton had submitted a deal sheet before the window closed at 23:00 BST to try to get the Balogun deal over the line.

Balogun had emerged as a late target after Guinea-Bissau frontman Beto completed a permanent move to Serie A club Fiorentina.

The Toffees did also explore moves for Manchester United striker Joshua Zirkzee and Aston Villa frontman Tammy Abraham, but were unable to convince either to join.

Also on transfer deadline day, Everton signed Jack Grealish on a season-long loan deal from Manchester City .

Grealish spent the 2025-26 season on loan with Everton , making 20 appearances, before sustaining a season-ending foot injury in January.

The 30-year-old had been linked with other teams - including boyhood club Aston Villa - but has opted to reunite with David Moyes on Merseyside.

"I think I'm at my best at everything in life, not just football, when I feel loved. That's what the manager has given me, what my teammates have given me and especially what the fans have given me," Grealish said.

"Every time I see an Everton fan, it's just pure love and the way they've welcomed me since that first game against Leeds , I'll never forget that."

Grealish, who joined City from Villa for £100m in August 2021, scored twice and provided six assists in 20 appearances during his previous spell with Everton - winning the Premier League Player of the Month for August.

The England international returned from injury during Manchester City 's Community Shield defeat against Arsenal on 16 August.

He also featured under Enzo Maresca in City's opening game of the 2026-27 Premier League season as they beat Bournemouth 2-1.

Everton have also completed the signing of Ainsley Maitland-Niles from French side Lyon.

The 29-year-old former Arsenal player has won five caps for England and can operate as a full-back or in midfield.

Meanwhile, Scotland right-back Nathan Patterson has completed a permanent move to Serie A club Torino.

Patterson, 24, joined Everton from Rangers in January 2022 and made 68 appearances across all competitions.

articles.title: Marc Casadó deja el Barça: se va cedido al Deportivo
articles.standfirst: El conjunto gallego se guarda una opción de compra de 30 millones
articles.summary: El conjunto gallego se guarda una opción de compra de 30 millones
articles.body: Marc Casadó deja el Barcelona. El futbolista catalán, de 22 años, jugará en el Deportivo hasta el mes de junio, lo hará a préstamo. No tenía sitio en la medular de Hansi Flick. El Barça hizo oficial esta noche, en el último día de mercado y en los minutos finales, la salida de Marc Casadó. El canterano azulgrana, que manejaba un gran número de ofertas nacionales y extranjeras, pone rumbo al Deportivo, donde militará en calidad de cedido. La entidad gallega se guarda una opción de compra de 30 millones y el conjunto catalán asume buena parte de su ficha. El catalán es una de las pieza clave que había solicitado Antonio Hidalgo. El interés viene de lejos, de la temporada en la que el Deportivo y el Barça B jugaban en Primera RFEF. El mediocentro catalán realizó una exhibición en el choque de Riazor y la dirección deportiva no le ha perdido la pista hasta que se ha puesto a tiro. El centrocampista llega en calidad de cedido y con una opción de compra por parte del bloque gallego. Con Amatucci como único futbolista de esas características en la plantilla, el jugador del Barcelona engrana las piezas del medio gallego. El medio catalán deja el Barcelona después de haber intervenido en 75 encuentros con la camiseta azulgrana. Casadó, que no había sido citado en los primeros encuentros de esta temporada, sabía desde hace meses que Hansi Flick no contaba con él y que no era una opción para la medular. Su situación, además, aún se vio más comprometida tras la llegada de Rodri. El técnico alemán cuenta con Bernal, Pedri, De Jong, Fermín, Olmo, Éric García... Casadó tiene contrato con el Barcelona hasta junio de 2028. Llegó a la cantera azulgrana en 2016 procedente del fútbol base del CF Damm y dio el salto al primer equipo culé en la campaña 22-23.

articles.title: El 3 que no pudo ser el último día
articles.standfirst: Pese a la negociación para incorporar libre a Tagliafico desde el Olympique de Lyon, el Atlético finalmente no llega a un acuerdo. La opción de Hugo Bueno también acaba desechándose
articles.summary: Pese a la negociación para incorporar libre a Tagliafico desde el Olympique de Lyon, el Atlético finalmente no llega a un acuerdo. La opción de Hugo Bueno también acaba desechándose
articles.body: Pese a que Mateu Alemany tenía en mente un último golpe de efecto con el fichaje de un lateral izquierdo en las últimas 24 horas del mercado, finalmente el Atlético cerraría el periodo de transferencias con las cinco caras nuevas (Grimaldo, Hjulmand, Kang-in Lee, Cuti Romero y Jonathan David) con que contará Simeone hasta al menos la ventana invernal. Nicolás Tagliafico, que había desbancado a Hugo Bueno en el casting que el director de fútbol profesional llevaría a cabo durante la jornada de este martes, acabaría cayéndose por más que su disponibilidad para vestir la camiseta rojiblanca era total. El campeón del mundo con Argentina en 2022, titular también en la final que coronó a España en el pasado 19 de julio, había paralizado todos los movimientos iniciados unos días antes por la Juventus para su fichaje desde el momento en que el Atlético entró en escena. Sin embargo, pese a su predisposición y al rápido entendimiento para alcanzar un acuerdo en cuanto a sus condiciones, la operación no acabaría viendo la luz. La premisa para su desembarco en el Metropolitano era muy clara: Mateu Alemany debía conseguir hacerle un hueco en la masa salarial de la plantilla para poder encajar su fichaje. Dicho de otro modo, su llegada quedaba condicionada por completo al éxito que el Atlético tuviera en la operación salida con Giménez, Lemar, Carlos Martín u Obed Vargas. Precisamente la ficha que percibía en el Olympique de Lyon era la llave que le abría sus puertas por más que su compromiso con el club se extendiera hasta 2027, pues la eliminación en el playoff de acceso a la fase Liga de la Champions acabaría de complicar la delicada situación económica por la que atraviesa la entidad gala. Sin embargo, la incertidumbre iba a venir marcada por la necesidad del Atlético de aligerar el coste de su plantilla. Así que mientras las horas se sucedían con el Atlético inmerso en cuatro operaciones de salida, Tagliafico seguía priorizando al rojiblanco sobre la Juventus y avanzando en su rescisión con el Olympique de Lyon. Pero, para su desgracia, a pesar de los movimientos realizados en los despachos del Metropolitano y a pesar de prácticamente todo el día poniendo de su parte para ser uno más a las órdenes de Simeone, finalmente el experimentado defensa de 34 años vería cómo el club rojiblanco no acababa de dar el paso definitivo. Para entonces, el Atlético ya había desechado la opción de un Hugo Bueno que un principio partía como el mejor colocado al representar la opción low cost que suponía su cesión desde el Wolverhampton pero que finalmente acabaría siendo relegado ante la jerarquía del argentino y a su mayor perfil defensivo. Unas virtudes con las que se pensaba complementar la vocación ofensiva de Grimaldo y que ahora tendrán que ser cubiertas por un eventual desplazamiento de Hancko.

articles.title: Giménez será el jefe de la zaga del Deportivo
articles.standfirst: Calidad y experiencia para una defensa que debuta en Primera
articles.summary: Llega cedido - calidad y experiencia para una defensa que debuta en Primera
articles.body: El Atlético de Madrid y el Deportivo de A Coruña lleGaron a un acuerdo para firmar la cesión de José María Giménez. El uruguayo que fue convocado por Bielsa para el último Mundial, aunque no disputó ningún minuto, aceptó la propuesta del Deportivo por delante de la del Sevilla o la del Valencia. José María Giménez aterriza en Riazor para apuntalar una defensa que lleva varias temporadas fallando a balón parado. El defensa central tiene 31 años y a pesar de que en los últimos años ha perdido protagonismo en los onces del Cholo Simeone es un jugador de mucha jerarquía. En la última temporada con el Atlético disputó 16 partidos en Liga y seis de Champions League. Llega cedido, sin opción de compra y el Atlético le ofrece un año más de contrato para compensar el salario que va a cobrar en el conjunto gallego. El Dépor pudo soltar lastre y varios jugadores dejaron masa salarial y fichas para los refuerzos. Jurado, Puerto, Patiño, Comas y Barcia eran los futbolistas que no cobraban con el ok del técnico que les indicó la salida.

articles.title: Iliman Ndiaye transfer news: Man City sign £65m winger from Everton as Jack Grealish joins Toffees on loan
articles.summary: Manchester City have completed the £65m signing of winger Iliman Ndiaye; City had an £80m bid for Liverpool's Cody Gakpo rejected on Monday and moved for Ndiaye as an alternative; Jack Grealish joins Everton on season-long loan which will take him to the end of his Man City deal
articles.body:
The deal comprises a £60m guaranteed payment plus £5m in bonuses.

Ndiaye, who had also been wanted by Tottenham, has signed a five-year contract at Manchester City.

Jack Grealish has gone the other way in a separate deal, returning to Everton on a season-long loan that covers the final year of his Man City contract.

But Manchester United have rejected Everton's offer to take Joshua Zirkzee on loan.

Sky Sports News understands Everton offered to pay a total fee of around £10m for Zirkzee, which included his wages for the season and a loan fee.

Ndiaye's City arrival comes after Liverpool rejected Manchester City's £80m bid for Cody Gakpo.

Sky Sports News understands Liverpool were concerned about their chances of bringing in a replacement for the Dutchman.

Manchester City wanted to sign a wide forward and a central midfielder before the window closes, with the club agreeing a joint-British record deal for Chelsea's Enzo Fernandez on Deadline Day.

City allowed Savio and Omar Marmoush to join Tottenham earlier this month, reducing Enzo Maresca's options on the wing.

City did not name a winger on their bench in Friday's win over Crystal Palace and started with Phil Foden - who Enzo Maresca admitted is not a winger - out wide at Selhurst Park.

Ndiaye, who becomes Manchester City's seventh summer signing, said: "I've worked my whole life for an opportunity like this.

"City are one of the best clubs in the world and I've seen them win everything as I've grown up.

"To be able to write my own chapter in a story that special is the chance of a lifetime and I'm determined to grab it with both hands.

"It's not always been easy in my career, but I always had the belief that I could play for a team challenging for the biggest prizes, and now I'm here. It feels so good.

"I love to play with the ball on the floor in an attacking team that wants to score as many goals as possible. That's why I know this is the perfect fit."

Manchester City director of football Hugo Viana added: "Iliman is a very talented footballer. He's had to work incredibly hard to reach this level and in my first conversation with him it was immediately obvious how grounded he is and the determination he has to be the best player he can be.

"I've no doubt City fans will get a thrill seeing him in action for us."

articles.title: Fernandez transfers to Man City from Chelsea in joint British record fee
articles.summary: Argentina international Enzo Fernandez signs for Manchester City in a deal from Chelsea worth £125 million ($169m).
articles.body:
Manchester City equalled the British transfer fee record for a player when they signed midfielder Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea on deadline day for deals in Europe.

The 25-year-old Argentina international, who was part of his country’s team that reached the 2026 World Cup final, had long been linked with a move away from Stamford Bridge.

The deal, however, was stretched to the final few minutes of the summer transfer window , which shut at 22:00 GMT on Tuesday.

City confirmed the deal with a video on the social media platform X, with the fee matching the 125 million pounds ($169m) that Liverpool paid Newcastle for Alexander Isak last summer.

The deal seemed to have been agreed upon between the clubs hours before the window shut, allowing for the player to complete a medical, but doubts about the deal started to emerge with the clock ticking on the deadline.

Fernandez himself had taken to his Instagram page ahead of the deadline on Tuesday to bid farewell to Chelsea fans.

“I want you to know that these have not been easy days for me. Writing this is not easy either. The truth is, I haven’t been in a good place,” Fernandez wrote in a message directed to fans of the London club.

“Three years ago, Cobham [the club’s training ground] and Stamford Bridge became home for me and my family.

“Believe me when I say that, from the moment I arrived, I became obsessed with winning and with bringing this club every trophy that its history deserves.

“We suffered, we cried, I got angry many times, but we also celebrated titles and unforgettable victories. Together, through the good times and the difficult ones.”

Fernandez was part of the Chelsea side that won the UEFA Conference League in 2025 before going on to claim the expanded FIFA Club World Cup that year.

City boss Enzo Maresca worked with Fernandez at Chelsea before taking on the daunting task of succeeding Pep Guardiola at the Etihad.

The Italian was a driving force behind the deal to land Fernandez after the recent sale of influential World Cup winner Rodri to Barcelona, as well as the departures of fellow midfielders Bernardo Silva, Nico Gonzalez and Tijjani Reijnders.

The 25-year-old will partner with England international Elliot Anderson and Moroccan Ayyoub Bouaddi in City’s revamped central midfield at a cost of more than 300 million pounds ($405.4m).

“Every player wants to be part of a club like this, because everyone knows how well-run City are,” said Fernandez in his statement released by City upon completion of the deal.

“This is a club built for success. If you look across the squad, City have quality in every area. I want to learn from my new teammates and become a better player.”

Fernandez, who signed for Chelsea from Benfica for 106 million pounds ($143.2m) in 2023, angered the Blues last season by expressing interest in joining Real Madrid, and was dropped for two matches as a result.

He scored twice in Argentina’s run to the World Cup final, including a stunning strike against England in the semifinal.

But his tournament ended with a red card in the final as Argentina were beaten 1-0 to miss out on retaining their status as world champions.

“He is a complete midfielder: technically gifted, hardworking, tenacious, and a goalscorer,” said City’s director of football Hugo Viana.

“To have played in two World Cup finals and won major trophies in multiple countries at just 25 says everything you need to know about his mentality, professionalism and technical quality.

“We are delighted to bring him here, and feel very strongly he will improve our team.”

articles.title: El cierre del mercado de Primera: Doble bombazo del Dépor y caza mayor de Elche y Racing
articles.standfirst: Giménez y Casadó llegaron cedidos a A Coruña, mientras que ilicitanos y cántabros ficharon a cuatro jugadores cada uno. La llegada de Ceballos al Betis fue oficial pasada la una de la madrugada
articles.summary: Giménez y Casadó llegaron cedidos a A Coruña, mientras que ilicitanos y cántabros ficharon a cuatro jugadores cada uno. La llegada de Ceballos al Betis fue oficial pasada la una de la madrugada
articles.body: Se acabó. El mercado de fichajes de verano ha echado el cierre con una jornada con mucho movimiento en los clubes de Primera división. El día arrancó a las 10.40 horas cuando el Racing de Santander anunció el fichaje de Aarón Martín, procedente del Genoa. Él fue el primero. Después, llegaron muchos más. En total, se completaron 26 operaciones. La última, pasada la una de la madrugada, fue la de Dani Ceballos. Uno de los bombazos de este mercado se hizo de rogar. El centrocampista, tras concluir su etapa en el Real Madrid, tenía arreglado su fichaje por el Betis, tal y como había informado MARCA a lo largo del día, pero su oficialidad llegó ya bien entrada la noche. Firma con los verdiblancos un contrato hasta 2029. Aunque llegó a la ciudad condal el lunes, la oficialidad de la incorporación de Gabriel Jesús se hizo este martes. El brasileño, por el que los culés han pagado al Arsenal 10 millones más variables, firma por tres temporadas. Del Barcelona, precisamente, llegó a A Coruña Marc Casadó, inscrito en LaLiga a falta de unos minutos para el cierre. Jugará cedido una campaña, lo mismo que Giménez, a préstamo del Atlético. Ambos completarán la plantilla de un equipo que se ha reforzado mucho y bien este verano. Jonathan David, a préstamo desde la Juventus, es el jugador que completó la delantera de Simeone. Los rojiblancos se guardan una opción de compra de 25 millones. Mucho movimiento en el Racing. Refuerzos en propiedad, con la llegada hasta 2027 de Aarón Martín, procedente del Genoa, y de Pablo García, del Betis, hasta 2030, un jugador por el que los cántabros desembolsaron 5,5 millones por el 50% de sus derechos. En forma de cesión aterrizaron André Almeida, del Valencia, y Jeanuël Belocian, del Bayer Leverkusen. También hubo salidas: Gustavo Puerta, importante en el equipo, se marchó a Olympiacos. Romain del Castillo, atacante francés que pertenecía al Stade Brestois 29, firmó por dos temporadas con otra opcional con el equipo rojillo. Costó un millón más 450.000 euros en variables. Aunque era un secreto a voces, la llegada de Harvey Elliott, que ya estaba en la ciudad desde el lunes, se oficializó este martes. El inglés, de 23 años, está cedido por el Liverpool hasta final de temporada en una operación que no incluye opción de compra. Tres refuerzos. Félix Correia, extremo izquierdo, jugará en el Pizjuán cedido por el Lille. Tiene 25 años y ya ha estado en Portugal, Países Bajos, Italia y Francia. A préstamo desde el Saint-Éttiene, también llegó el atacante Lucas Stassin, internacional absoluto con Bélgica a sus 21 años. Y el centrocampista Youssouf Fofana, cedido por el Milan. Un central uruguayo para apuntalar la zaga. Sebastián Cáceres, que llevaba seis temporadas y media en el Club América, fichó hasta junio de 2030. Es el jugador que reclamaba Giráldez para el eje de la zaga. Mujaid Sadick se convirtió en nuevo futbolista franjirrojo tras el acuerdo alcanzado con el KRC Genk para su cesión. El meta Emil Audero, cedido por el Como, estaba inscrito en LaLiga, aunque el club no lo había hecho oficial. Viene para reforzar la portería tras la lesión de Batalla. También llegaría cedido Rayane, del Atlético Madrileño, otro aún sin confirmar. Primero, incorporó libre a Juan Berrocal, que se desvinculó del Getafe. El central firma hasta junio de 2027. Después, a Jens Cajuste, mediocampista cedido por el Nápoles con opción de compra no obligatoria de ocho millones. Iván Azón, delantero de 23 años, reforzó el ataque azulón tras el acuerdo con el Como 1907 para la cesión por una temporada. Incorporó a un campeón del mundo: Thomas Lemar aterrizó en el Martínez Valero cedido por un año por el Atlético. Además, Rubén Sánchez, lateral derecho ex del Espanyol, fichó hasta 2029, con opción de ampliar una temporada más. Costó medio millón de euros. También Roy Revivo, hijo del ex jugador Haim Revivo, llegó traspasado procedente del Maccabi Tel Aviv. El lateral izquierdo se comprometió hasta 2030. Y Kevin Lomónaco reforzará el centro de la defensa después de que los ilicitanos pagaran su cláusula a Independiente de Avellaneda. En cuanto a salidas, David Affengruber fue traspasado al Fulham. Un refuerzo para la defensa. Firmó a Gorosabel, cedido por el Athletic con una opción de compra obligatoria sujeta a objetivos. El delantero Petar Ratkov, internacional con Serbia, llegó a préstamo desde la Lazio por este curso. Alavés, Athletic, Real Madrid, Real Sociedad y Villarreal vivieron en calma el día del cierre del mercado. Ninguno de ellos realizó ninguna incorporación de última hora. El Athletic ha vivido un mercado atípico. Los leones no han fichado a ningún jugador en el periodo estival. Diferentes hasta en esto. Mikel González, director general de Fútbol, explicaba los motivos en Movistar LaLiga: “No hemos hecho incorporaciones, pero sí hubo bastantes ventas. Es un año sin Europa y el club tenía que ajustar ese mercado”.

articles.title: Sergio Akieme no llega a tiempo y se queda sin fichar por el Levante
articles.standfirst: El lateral español no podrá recalar en el conjunto granota después de que la documentación necesaria para su inscripción no llegara dentro del plazo establecido por LaLiga.
articles.summary: El lateral español no podrá recalar en el conjunto granota después de que la documentación necesaria para su inscripción no llegara dentro del plazo establecido por LaLiga.
articles.body: El Levante se quedó sin uno de los refuerzos que tenía previstos para cerrar el mercado de fichajes. Sergio Akieme no jugará finalmente en el conjunto granota después de que la operación no pudiera completarse a tiempo ante LaLiga, impidiendo la inscripción del futbolista pese a que el acuerdo entre las partes estaba totalmente cerrado. El lateral izquierdo madrileño tenía acordada su llegada a Orriols como cedido procedente del Stade Rennais, una incorporación que respondía a una petición de la dirección deportiva y de Luis Castro para reforzar una posición considerada prioritaria dentro de la plantilla. Sin embargo, los trámites finales no pudieron completarse dentro del plazo establecido y la operación terminó frustrándose en los últimos instantes del mercado. La intención del jugador era regresar al fútbol español tras varias temporadas en Francia. Aunque el Almería, club en el que rindió a gran nivel, también estudió su incorporación durante este verano, el futbolista había dado prioridad a la propuesta del Levante y a la posibilidad de competir por un puesto en el once junto a Manu Sánchez. Akieme, de 28 años, cuenta con una trayectoria consolidada en el fútbol profesional. Formado en las categorías inferiores del Rayo Vallecano, continuó su crecimiento en el FC Barcelona B antes de convertirse en una pieza fundamental del Almería, donde participó en el ascenso a Primera División y se consolidó posteriormente en la máxima categoría. Su rendimiento le abrió las puertas del fútbol francés en 2023, cuando fue traspasado al Stade Rennais. Con contrato en vigor hasta 2028, el defensa ha sido un futbolista habitual en la rotación del conjunto bretón. La pasada temporada disputó 36 encuentros oficiales entre liga y copa, confirmando su regularidad y experiencia en una de las principales competiciones europeas..

articles.title: El Rayo ficha a Audero para cubrir la baja de Batalla
articles.standfirst: Cesión del guardameta italiano del Como hasta final de temporada
articles.summary: Cesión del guardameta italiano del Como hasta final de temporada
articles.body: El portero italo-indonesio Emil Audero jugará cedido esta temporada en el Rayo Vallecano por el Como 1907, tras ser elegido sustituto del argentino Augusto Batalla, lesionado en la segunda jornada del campeonato liguero. Audero, de 29 años, peleará por un puesto de titular con Dani Cárdenas y buscará los minutos que no iba a tener en el Como 1907 tras la llegada de Robert Sánchez al equipo italiano. El internacional indonesio ha desarrollado toda su carrera en Italia. Se formó en la cantera de la Juventus, club del que salió en 2017 para jugar cedido primero en el Venezia y después en la Sampdoria, en la que se quedó de 2018 a 2023. Ese año se marchó al Inter de Milán, con el que apenas disputó seis partidos antes de fichar por el Como, en el que sin asentarse encadenó dos cesiones seguidas a Palermo y Cremonese, con el que disputó la pasada campaña 35 partidos. Audero es el sexto refuerzo del Rayo Vallecano en el mercado de verano tras las incorporaciones del central italo-albano Marash Kumbulla, el extremo Giorgi Tsitaishvili, el pivote español Gnangoro Bouaré, el lateral izquierdo español Adrià Pedrosa y el central Mujaid Sadick.

articles.title: Crystal Palace: Palace sign Ben Chilwell and Quinten Timber after deadline
articles.summary: Crystal Palace have signed internationals Ben Chilwell and Quinten Timber on permanent deals
articles.body:
Crystal Palace have completed the permanent signings of experienced internationals Ben Chilwell and Quinten Timber.

England defender Chilwell returns to Selhurst Park from RC Strasbourg after spending the second half of the 2024-25 campaign on loan with the Eagles.

Netherlands international Timber arrives from Marseille and has signed a five-year deal with the Conference League winners.

Palace also signed Chile winger Dario Osorio from FC Midtjylland on a season-long loan.

"It's amazing to be back," said Chilwell, who won the FA Cup with Palace in May 2025.

"It's nice to see some familiar faces, and I'm just really excited to get back in, see the boys and the fans, and get going again."

Palace were able to complete both deals after Tuesday's 23:00 BST transfer deadline by submitting deal sheets to the Premier League.

Chilwell, who has been capped 21 times by England, has previously played for Chelsea, Leicester City and Huddersfield Town.

He spent last season with Strasbourg after joining the Ligue 1 side from Chelsea in September 2025.

Timber, 25, is the brother of Arsenal defender Jurrien Timber. He has been capped 13 times by the Netherlands and was part of their squad for this summer's World Cup.

articles.title: Pablo García se marcha desolado y sus padres rompen a llorar: "Lo estamos pasando mal"
articles.standfirst: La despedida de la perla bética, entre lágrimas
articles.summary: La despedida de la perla bética, entre lágrimas
articles.body: La salida de Pablo García del Betis en dirección Santander sorprendió a media tarde y dejó una de las imágenes del cierre del mercado. El jugador, que salía de las instalaciones del club en un coche conducido por su madre, rompió a llorar tras el cristal de la ventanilla y no pudo casi articular palabra ante los periodistas. Su padre Ramón habló en El Partidazo de Cope y resumió el sentir de la familia. "¿Habéis visto al niño y a la madre no? Ha ido a su taquilla a por sus cosas... y lo estamos pasando mal", dijo entre lágrimas: "Bueno, ya cuando empiece a entrenar y eso, pues él lo va a dar todo y él va a hacer feliz a la gente del Racing, seguro". Sobre el momento en el que Pablo se ha enterado de que iba a salir traspasado al Racing, su padre dijo: "Muy tarde, porque eso ha surgido este mediodía o no sé. A media tarde por ahí surgió la historia y hemos estado esperando hasta que se cerrase todo, hasta bastante tarde". "Está claro que al niño siempre lo que le interesaba este año con 20 años es intentar jugar lo máximo posible. Y aquí sabemos el plantillón que tenemos y el montón de futbolistas buenísimos que hay, entonces estábamos entre quedarte aquí y disfrutar los minutos que te fueran tocando o intentar buscar una salida para él para relanzar su carrera y poder jugar y disfrutar del fútbol que es lo que él quiere", aseguró sobre la decisión de buscar una salida del Betis.

articles.title: Enzo Fernandez transfer news: Man City sign midfielder from Chelsea in British-record-equalling £125m deal
articles.summary: Enzo Fernandez joins Man City from Chelsea for £125m; Fee matches British record Liverpool paid Newcastle for Alexander Isak last summer; Chelsea furious that Monaco pulled out of deal to sell Lamine Camara as replacement for Fernandez
articles.body:
The size of the fee matches the amount Liverpool paid Newcastle for Alexander Isak on Deadline Day a year ago. The Argentine midfielder has signed a five-year deal at the Etihad Stadium.

The Fernandez deal comes amid Chelsea fury that Monaco pulled out of selling Lamine Camara - who was deemed as the Argentine's replacement - in the final minutes of the window.

Chelsea had the option of pulling the plug on Fernandez to Man City after the Camara deal collapsed - but they stuck to their word and honoured their commitment to complete the deal.

Fernandez's Deadline Day move comes more than three months after the Argentina international first told Chelsea he wanted to leave, and more than two weeks after the club imposed a deadline for bids.

Chelsea will make a £18m profit on the midfielder they signed for £107m three-and-a-half years ago, and Fernandez is now reunited with his former Chelsea boss Enzo Maresca.

"Manchester City are the most successful club in England in recent times," said Fernandez after making the move.

"Every player wants to be part of a club like this because everyone knows how well-run City are.

"I could not be happier to be here, and I am ready for the challenge of helping City continue winning trophies. This is a club built for success.

"If you look across the squad, City have quality in every area. I want to learn from my new teammates and become a better player.

"I pride myself on continually improving my game. Anyone who's worked with me will know how hard I train every single day and how much I put into matches. I give absolutely everything and I can promise Manchester City that will continue now I'm here."

Camara was set to join Chelsea for £47m and was going to sign a six-year deal pending a medical.

Just after the 11pm transfer deadline passed, news emerged that Monaco reneged on the agreement they had with Chelsea, and they had informed the Blues of their decision in writing.

The reason for Monaco pulling out was due to the French club successfully renegotiating the deal to sell Folarin Balogun to Everton.

There was a full written club-to-club agreement with Chelsea to complete the Camara deal and the Premier League club feels Monaco have acted in an extraordinary and deeply unprofessional way.

Fernandez sends farewell message to Chelsea

Enzo Fernandez in his Chelsea farewell Instagram message:

I want you to know that these have not been easy days for me. Writing this is not easy either. The truth is, I haven't been in a good place.

Three years ago, Cobham and Stamford Bridge became home for me and my family. I grew attached to the people, to the shirt, and to the badge of this incredible club.

Believe me when I say that, from the moment I arrived, I became obsessed with winning and with bringing this club every trophy that its history deserves. We suffered, we cried, I got angry many times, but we also celebrated titles and unforgettable victories. Together, through the good times and the difficult ones.

I live football the same way I live my life: with passion and with all my heart. That is why I want you to know that I understand you. I truly understand you, from the bottom of my heart.

But life is about making decisions, and right now I find myself having to make one of those difficult decisions. I've said it before, but I want to say it again: I have grown incredibly fond of this club. Chelsea will always have a place in my thoughts and, above all, in my heart.

But I also understand how football works. I know how passionate you are, because I am the same. And if I were in your position, I would probably be thinking the same way.

I want to thank every single one of you: the staff, the coaching team, the medical team, the physios, and everyone who works at Cobham and throughout this great institution.

To all my teammates over these years, thank you from the bottom of my heart for sharing so many moments with me. I was truly happy here, and I wish you nothing but the very best for the future.

Thank you for all the love and support you have given me and my family throughout these years. I will never forget it.

This group will give you many more reasons to be happy, and I will be happy for you too. Never doubt that.

You will always be in my heart, Blues. I will always wish you, always, nothing but the very best.

articles.title: Malick Fofana: Sunderland finally complete signing of Lyon winger after Deadline Day drama with Crystal Palace
articles.summary: Malick Fofana has joined Sunderland in a £30.8m move - but the player nearly joined Crystal Palace on Deadline Day; Arsenal were also considering a move for Fofana but did not make a move; it was a saga of one medical, two teams and two private jets
articles.body:
Sunderland agreed a deal to sign Fofana on Deadline Day morning but Crystal Palace - whose manager Pierre Sage worked with him before at Lyon - tried to hijack the deal.

With both Premier League clubs agreeing a deal with Lyon for the winger, Fofana was then sat at Lyon airport, with two private jets waiting on him to make a decision. One plane was set for Sunderland, the other was set for London.

Fofana also took one medical in Lyon on Deadline Day that both teams had access to.

But just over an hour to go until the deadline, Fofana eventually chose Sunderland with Black Cats owner Kyril Louis-Dreyfus travelling to Lyon to convince the player to join.

Fofana's move to Sunderland consists of an initial £25.7m with £5.14m in add-ons.

Arsenal were also considering a move for Fofana over the weekend but did not make a move for the player.

10:47am: After Arsenal did not take up the chance to sign Fofana, Sunderland agreed a deal with Lyon for the winger worth up to £30m.

1:01pm: Crystal Palace try to hijack Sunderland's five-year deal for Fofana by entering in direct communication with the player in an attempt to convince him to join them.

3:18pm: Crystal Palace agree a deal with Lyon for Fofana. Sunderland begin talks with fellow Belgium winger Dodi Lukebakio on top of the Fofana deal.

3.42pm: Fofana is at Lyon airport with two private jets waiting on him to make a decision - one bound for Sunderland and another for London.

8:24pm: Sunderland owner Kyril Louis-Dreyfus visits Lyon to try and persuade Fofana to choose Sunderland over Palace. The player effectively undergoes one medical for both teams.

9:38pm: Sunderland's attempts to sign Benfica's Lukebakio end as a decision is made for him to remain with the Portuguese club.

9:50pm: Fofana gives Sunderland the green light after changing his mind multiple times throughout the day. The price of the deal rises to £30.8m.

10:54pm: Sunderland submit a deal sheet to get the Fofana deal over the line.

12:15am: Sunderland announce the Fofana deal

articles.title: Folarin Balogun: Monaco striker's move to Everton falls through after deal scuppered Chelsea's chances of signing Lamine Camara
articles.summary: Folarin Balogun arrived on Merseyside at lunchtime on Deadline Day to complete the £40m move to Everton from Monaco; after midnight, it was confirmed that Balogun had a change of heart after the move also scuppered Chelsea's chances of signing Lamine Camara from Monaco
articles.body:
Balogun arrived on Merseyside at lunchtime to complete the £40m Deadline Day transfer, but doubts then started to emerge about the deal being completed during the afternoon as the medical threw up an issue.

As a result of this issue, Monaco then proceeded with a move to sell midfielder Camara. But in another twist, Everton renegotiated the terms of the deal for Balogun - which forced a dramatic move from Monaco.

With a full agreement to sell Camara to Chelsea in place, Monaco withdrew from the deal as the 11pm transfer deadline passed, which left the Blues furious.

Chelsea also had the chance to withdraw from the £125m move to sell Enzo Fernandez to Man City, but chose not to out of good faith.

But just after midnight on Wednesday, it was revealed Balogun had a change of heart about moving to Everton and walked away from the deal - which will only infuriate Monaco and Chelsea even more.

It also means Balogun's dramatic 2026 continues - after the American international was at the centre of the World Cup red card storm involving Donald Trump .

The Balogun drama in chronological order

Everton agree fee with Monaco for Folarin Balogun.

Balogun arrives on Merseyside for medical and to complete formalities of the move.

Chelsea have multiple bids rejected by Monaco for Lamine Camara. They consider other targets.

Chelsea agree deal to sell Enzo Fernandez to Man City for £125m. Comfortable with the options in their squad if no one comes in.

Doubts emerge around Everton's deal for Balogun.

Everton make an offer to sign Joshua Zirkzee from Manchester United on loan with an option to buy.

Chelsea agree deal with Monaco for Lamine Camara, due to the doubts about the Balogun deal.

Manchester United reject Everton's loan offer for Zirkzee.

Everton grow in confidence that they can get Balogun over the line after renegotiating with Monaco.

Chelsea's deal to sign Camara collapses after Monaco withdraw from the deal. The Balogun deal being back on satisfied their need for a sale.

Balogun had a change of heart and walked away from the deal after a deal sheet was submitted.

Sky Sports News' Kaveh Solhekol on Chelsea's Lamine Camara's Chelsea move breaking down:

"Chelsea have not been able to sign a replacement for Enzo Fernandez. Chelsea are really unhappy with the way Monaco behaved.

"My information is everything was done - written, agreed, signed. He was flying into London [on Wednesday].

"At the same time, Monaco have been negotiating with Everton to sell Folarin Balogun. Once they have agreed a deal with Everton, they have come back to Chelsea and gone back on their agreement.

"Chelsea don't believe this is the way clubs should conduct business. I suppose this is one of the risks you take when you leave things so late."
